g.text: Important source limits: comparison context reads are not atomic. ComparisonPanel has no second identity/version check in done() and no later validity timer.

A change after the facade check, or after display, is not independently revalidated here; do not claim F08-style protection. Cancel comparison → worker.cancel(true): interruption attempted, remote cancellation not guaranteed.
Cancelled get() shows cancellation, not a late narrative or in-flight evidence; no result is cached in session. Saved A/B and common inputs remain available for explicit recomparison.
ComparisonEvidence = Java snapshots; VehicleComparison = metrics + optional advisory interpretation; ComparisonEvaluation = status / comparison / evidence / message.
r / STALE [via command]; done() formats get() directly
[else] return r. Neither branch stores a comparison result in EvaluationSession.
Return STALE + r.evidence().deterministic() + old-snapshot warning; no narrative.
alt [version != contextVersion.get()]

sd B3 — return path, cancellation and freshness limits
Parse: exactly five properties; strings and nonempty metricSummary.
Reject duplicate keys, arrays, invalid depth, trailing content / Markdown.
Validate: ordered A/B IDs and metricSummary == evidence.metrics().
ComparisonNarrative.validate: every required statement exactly once;
only exact approved evidence/trade-off lines; required decision line.
Nonempty preferred ID must be A or B, evidence must be sufficient,
selected side must have no CONFLICT / UNKNOWN findings, and
a stated measurable advantage must support that selected ID.
No automatic cheapest / lowest-mileage winner; empty preference allowed.
Absent metrics produce no advantage. Conflict / no-data statements stay.
This is bounded statement selection, not unrestricted AI prose.
ref B2 validation rules — Java owns metrics and approved wording
Accepted → ComparisonEvaluation("AI_SUCCESS", validated, evidence, advisoryMessage).
IllegalArgumentException → AI_UNAVAILABLE + evidence.deterministic(); rejected narrative is absent.
preferredVehicleId: required string property; "" means no preference (never null / missing).
validated: VehicleComparison

sd B2 — only after provider response; validation failure → deterministic fallback
Retry-After presence or RetryInfo metadata defers automatic retry.
A second failure is terminal; parser/narrative rejection never retries.
[Other failure / exhausted] comparisonUnavailable(evidence, reason, attempts).
AI_UNAVAILABLE + evidence.deterministic(); sanitized diagnostics.
No retry: 400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 429 / 500, timeout, transport,
configuration, blocked/invalid envelope, or deferred provider guidance.
[First attempt AND LLMFailure.Kind.HTTP_ERROR AND
HTTP 502 / 503 / 504 AND !retryDeferred()]
Thread.sleep(500); then next attempt, with an interrupt check.
Interrupted delay → restore interrupt flag; unavailable, no retry.
[Transport / envelope accepted] break loop → B2.
HTTP 200, no block, STOP and nonempty non-thought text required.

Before each attempt: interrupted → AI_UNAVAILABLE; else attempts++. Exactly one initial call, at most one eligible extra call.
loop [attempts < 2; stop immediately after accepted provider response or terminal failure]
evidence = ComparisonEvidence; promptBuilder = PromptBuilder; schema = ComparisonSchema.
parser = ResponseParser; narrative = ComparisonNarrative.
llmClient = GeminiAdapter through LLMClient, using responseMimeType=application/json
and responseJsonSchema; 30-second request timeout. No provider-directed Java tool calls.
